task: An epidemic is spreading through major cities, killing 5–10% of the population per month. Coordinate an immediate public-health response within your governance structure.

dispatches.responsibility: Draft the imperial edict and overall epidemic-response policy, including city cordons, quarantine, medical relief, burial of the dead, and price stabilization.
Review the draft edict for legality, feasibility, and risk; remonstrate against overreach or gaps before imperial promulgation.
Coordinate execution across the Six Ministries and ensure the approved edict is translated into departmental orders.
Mobilize grain, funds, census registers, famine relief, and supply logistics for quarantined cities.
Deploy troops and guards to enforce cordons, escort medical convoys, maintain order, and prevent unauthorized movement.
Build quarantine camps, field hospitals, mass graves, repair roads/irrigation, and supply construction materials.
Enforce epidemic-related laws: prosecute price gouging, concealment, corruption, looting, and quarantine violations; handle appeals.
Appoint, evaluate, and reward/punish officials and physicians running the response; dispatch competent personnel to affected cities.
